package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"github.com/ishii1648/codex-issue-loop/internal/adapter/state"
)

func run() error {
	mode, dir := os.Args[1], os.Args[2]
	store := state.Store{Dir: dir, RepoID: "repo-deadbeef", RepoPath: "/tmp/repo"}
	if mode == "write" {
		if err := store.Initialize(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		initial, err := store.Load()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[3])
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fields); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(initial)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var envelope map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &envelope); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		for _, key := range []string{"version", "semantic_contract_version", "issue_lifecycle_api_version"} {
			delete(fields, key)
			if value, ok := envelope[key]; ok {
				fields[key] = value
			}
		}
		data, err = json.Marshal(fields)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		var snapshot state.Snapshot
		if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := snapshot.Validate(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = store.Update("contract_fixture", 0, "", nil, func(s *state.Snapshot) error { *s = snapshot; return nil })
		return err
	}
	if mode != "read" {
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown mode")
	}
	snapshot, _, err := store.ReadDiagnosticSnapshot()
	result := struct {
		Accepted bool            `json:"accepted"`
		Error    string          `json:"error,omitempty"`
		Snapshot *state.Snapshot `json:"snapshot,omitempty"`
	}{Accepted: err == nil}
	if err != nil {
		result.Error = err.Error()
	} else {
		result.Snapshot = &snapshot
	}
	return json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(result)
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
